in_scope.instructions:
The scope of this Vulnerability Disclosure Program includes all digital services of ADAC e.V., ADAC SE, and ADAC Stiftung, including their majority-owned subsidiaries and affiliated companies. Third-party systems and services that are not majority-owned or operated by ADAC are excluded unless explicitly listed as in scope. 

**The following third parties are definied out of scope:**
* Allianz
* Bank 11
* Solaris
* meinauto.de
* ADAC Fahrsicherheitszentren
* ADAC Regionalclubs


**Out of Scope – Assets Covered by the Private Bug Bounty Program**
The following assets are covered by ADAC's private Bug Bounty Program and are therefore out of scope for this Vulnerability Disclosure Program:
* ahp.adac.de
* login.adac.de
* https://www.adac.de/mein-adac
* https://www.adac.de/mein-adac/meine-persoenlichen-daten/notfallpass/infoseite/
* https://www.adac.de/services/pannenhilfe/pannenhilfe-online
* autovermietung.adac.de
* pincamp.com
* sndpartner.adac.de
* schluessel.adac.de
* https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.adac.mobile.pannenhilfe&hl=de&pli=1
* https://apps.apple.com/de/app/adac-pannenhilfe/id406968474
* bewerbung.adac.de
* mft.adac.de
* myit.adac.de
* www.adac-intranet.de
* https://portal.stiftung.adac.de/de/user/login
* adac.de
* *.adac.de
* *.adac-motorsport.de
* adac-ehrenamt.de

Note: Vulnerabilities affecting any of the above assets should be submitted through the dedicated ADAC Private Bug Bounty Program and not through this Vulnerability Disclosure Program.
